2ndxi.message: Hey team, you guys have early release for 2.30pm. Will and I will be driving the vans, please be outside the small gym at 2.35pm.

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, hope you have all had a good week!

Just trying to get a gauge as to numbers around transport tomorrow. Please respond to this poll if you are available for the game if you will need a van or not going to the game. The van will come back to college once the first 11 game has finished. 

Cheers, 
Will Litchfield
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: We have found a ref!

2ndxi.author: Keita Elliott

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Game tomorrow is at home vs MAGS, will be a wet pitch so if you have metal stud boots please bring them. 

Be there 9am for a 10am K.O. 

Cheers, let’s get another win 💪💯
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
What a performance today lads, 4 goals, clean sheet and controlled the game incredibly well. Congratulations! 

Enjoy your weekends, parents thank you for all your support! See you all next week at training 👏
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Game info tomorrow, meet at selwyn changing rooms at 9:00am for a 10:00am ko. 

Huge game against Howick tomorrow, let’s give them a big fight and come away with the win 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Because it suits most people, we will do a 2:30pm-3:45 training tomorrow.

See you all then.
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

With exams this week, I’m aware the latest exam finishes at 2pm? (Correct me if I’m wrong), would you guys want to do a 2:30pm training time start instead to make it easier for everyone? 

Thumbs up to this message if so!

Thanks
